text: What his story will be. I reckon he'll confine himself to the nervous origin of her recent illness. His notes will be truthful, but what he leaves out will matter most. Strange how just then Philip was so certain that Nicholas would never betray him. He loved Sandra too deeply to ruin her future happiness. Had ever circumstances conspired so unwittingly? Philip's spirits soared. rllbe L`rckor ft te hesvou fillrer. her pece lasle lore out Will malfer mot. n02. Hen Philip na? air HatNichola Helovea ryyom WA TrMoerea
